title: A Complete Hash-Anchoring Stack for AI Governance Evidence: STAMP/RECOVER/RECONCILE/GRAPH/BLOCK-TRACK Services, Zero-Trust Examiner Mode, and a Four-Part Tokenization-Field Adoption Program (MHCN-2 RWA Evidence, EVM Mirror, SBOM Anchoring)
description:
SQUIRL OS RESEARCH DISCLOSURE — READ FIRST: AI-assisted, receipt-first research program (open-book doctrine: audit-and-correction, versioned amendments, append-only public ledger). Errors are disclosed, not erased. This software is a prototype and is provided for educational and research purposes only. It is not intended for production use, commercial deployment, or safety-critical environments. All payloads synthetic; no customer-identifiable data appears in this record (POL-DISC-001).

The complete, working stack for chain-anchored evidence — five deterministic services plus a four-part adoption program aimed at the tokenization field. This record publishes the full corpus built and adversarially tested in a single session: the STAMP / RECOVER / RECONCILE / GRAPH / BLOCK-TRACK anchor services (SIP-034..038, scripts included, runnable), the Examiner Mode (SIP-039) that compiles a zero-trust evidence file from live gate verdicts, and the tokenization adoption program: MHCN-2 draft (RWA evidence lifecycle receipts: event-time anchoring, authority chaining, redactable-artifact/provable-existence), EVM mirror concept (read-only Merkle-root bridge so smart contracts can verify Bitcoin anchors — no tokens, no custody; deployment gated on owner decisions, honestly recorded as not deployed), and SBOM anchoring with a working self-referential demo (an SPDX-2.3 SBOM of the stack, stamped on Bitcoin and admitted to the reconciliation gate).

Provenance, disclosed in full: during assembly the reconciliation gate caught four genuine drift events (ledger advancing through sealed entries; the block registry rewriting itself tracking new receipts) — all absorbed by the certified-state mechanism, nothing deleted, nothing scrubbed — and the program's own ledger required one self-correction (entry 0174 claimed PASS while the gate returned FAIL; corrected in entry 0175 with the error left visible). The Examiner Mode's first output file faithfully recorded the FAIL verdict while the ledger claim was wrong — the tool being more honest than its operator is the strongest evidence this stack works. Conformance doctrine: claims without receipts are theater.

Companion records: MHCN-1 standard DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23445938; chain-of-custody graph DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23445728; SBR-7 randomized audit DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23445803. Dual Mesh Benchmark status: NOT MEASURED in this record (no neural-mesh inference involved; deterministic services only); program benchmark DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23321637 (DeepSeek column 10.5281/zenodo.23345241). Scope caveats (load-bearing): anchoring proves existence, not authority (PQC authority split retained; reference chain signatures are not post-quantum); MHCN-2 and the EVM mirror are sealed concepts, not deployed integrations; prototype software, no production warranty. Provenance: append-only public ledger entries 0168-0176, github.com/LLong2026/four-horsemen. DCAI community: zenodo.org/communities/dcai. Two-key curation: drafted and vetted by the system (Gabriel), published on the owner's explicit GO (chat authorization, 2026-10-17 ~23:31 CT).
